753:t_200:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「You're just like $$ワイズマン#pilot$$ and $$ペールゼン$$.」

753:t_200:7.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Let me tell you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. None of us will submit to anyone's rule...」

753:t_201:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You live for unrequited love, poor $$テイタニア$$... I shall free you from that suffering.」

753:t_201:1.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「You slip into the cracks in people's hearts and whisper sweet promises... False gods use the same methods everywhere.」

753:t_201:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Only your ignorance makes you think I am the same as a mere $$ワイズマン#pilot$$.」

753:t_201:3.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I can't trust a glib man...! I'll face you as a warrior!」

753:t_201:4.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I'll end this, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! This world has no need for an arrogant god!」

753:t_202:0.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「You claim to be God and rule over people... You are my enemy.」

753:t_202:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「No, $$シャッコ$$. Understand that you are now meeting the true God.」

753:t_202:2.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「You reject everyone else and justify only yourself... In the end, you're no different from $$ワイズマン#pilot$$.」

753:t_202:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Very well, hero of $$クエント$$. Though you expelled the gifted ones, I shall teach you that some things are still beyond you.」

753:t_202:4.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「I'll accept your challenge, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_202:5.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Spirits of $$クエント$$'s heroes! Lend me your strength to protect this world!!」

753:t_203:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Ignorance is frightening, $$桂$$. You understand nothing of your significance as the final key to repairing space-time.」

753:t_203:1.en:
$$桂$$
「We won't get that chance unless we deal with you, a mass of the force that seeks to vanish!」

753:t_203:2.en:
$$オルソン$$
「We'll fulfill our mission after we get you out of the way!」

753:t_203:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「People like you would bear the fate of every parallel world?」

753:t_203:4.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't want to hear that from someone who lacks even that resolve, calls himself God and watches the universe perish!」

753:t_203:5.en:
$$モーム$$
「That's right, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! $$桂$$ has resolved to fight for all life!」

753:t_203:6.en:
$$桂$$
「There's one more reason! I'm fighting to see the woman I love again!」

753:t_203:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then I shall annihilate you and erase hope from this universe!」

753:t_203:10.en:
$$桂$$
「That's good, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You're much more human that way than with your aloof, saintly facade!」

753:t_203:11.en:
$$桂$$
「We'll end this, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We'll surpass you and live...」

753:t_203:12.en:
$$桂$$
「...to move into the future beyond with those we love!!」

753:t_204:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am sorry, $$セツコ$$. My mistake has changed the circumstances.」

753:t_204:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I seek your $$スフィア$$ to regain the eternity $$アサキム$$ stole from me as well.」

753:t_204:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If you mean to stop the universe's collapse, I'll help you...」

753:t_204:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But you...! You only think about yourself!」

753:t_204:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Everything in this universe existed only for me! That is all I need to think!」

753:t_204:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「It's a shame that, when I finally hear your true words, that's what they are...」

753:t_204:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But in that case, I'll fight with all my strength too! I'll protect our future from you!」

753:t_204:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Come, $$ハマリエル・ザ・スター$$! Offer that power to $$至高神Ｚ$$!!」

753:t_204:10.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm $$セツコ・オハラ$$ of $$グローリー・スター$$...! My duty is to protect civilians' peace and freedom...!」

753:t_204:11.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Now I'll show my true worth! I'll defeat you with this $$バルゴラ・グローリーＳ$$!!」

753:t_205:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We'll settle our ties and the universe's tomorrow here, all at once!」

753:t_205:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Come, $$ウェルキエル・ザ・ヒート$$! I'll take your $$傷だらけの獅子$$ to regain eternity!」

753:t_205:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's good! I like you better with your emotions showing than as your usual aloof pretty boy!」

753:t_205:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...I cannot match you, $$ランド$$.」

753:t_205:5.en:
$$メール$$
「Of course you can't! Darling is the best man in the world... in the universe!」

753:t_205:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But I too have the resolve and pride to call myself God! I'll overpower the likes of you head-on!」

753:t_205:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「You've still got a long way to go, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! A guy who only thinks of himself when it counts can't beat a repairman working for everyone!」

753:t_205:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's fire up, $$ガンレオン$$! We hammer twisted things straight! That's how $$ビーター・サービス$$ does it!!」

753:t_205:9.en:
$$メール$$
「Go, go, Darling! Go, go, $$ガンレオン$$!!」

753:t_205:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「You, $$メール$$ and I will do this! We'll repair the universe's future!!」

753:t_206:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Why do you reject me, $$クロウ$$? The new world has none of the debt that torments you.」

753:t_206:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Wiping away what I've done isn't my style.」

753:t_206:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let me tell you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. Every 1 G I repay wins me 1 G's worth of freedom...」

753:t_206:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Repaying my debt is how I move toward the future...! Wiping it away is the same as crushing my future!」

753:t_206:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Repaying debt moves you toward the future...!? I cannot understand...!」

753:t_206:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's hilarious that a man who calls himself God can't understand such simple logic.」

753:t_206:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Basically, you're in the way, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You'll have to disappear for my future and the universe's!」

753:t_206:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I won't let you, $$ズリエル・ジ・アンブレイカブル$$! I'll seize your $$揺れる天秤$$ and obtain eternity again!」

753:t_206:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're a fool, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll teach you that a moment's brilliance of life is worth far more than eternity!」

753:t_206:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let's go, $$リ・ブラスタ$$! The combat data for shooting down an enemy who even warps causality will pay off my balance in one go!!」

753:t_207:0.en:
$n
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$... The time has finally come.」

753:t_207:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「There is no mercy for you who rejected me. You will vanish beyond causality.」

753:t_207:4.en:
$n
「Even if you had ulterior motives, I'd have died in the $$時獄戦役$$ without you...」

753:t_207:6.en:
$n
「Now I've settled that debt! The real fight starts here!」

753:t_207:8.en:
$n
「I'll defeat you to avenge Dad, Mom and Sis, and to protect the lives and future of the entire universe!」

753:t_207:11.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Just as you followed your heart, I shall speak of my honest feelings now.」

753:t_207:12.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$n... I am glad I met you, who surpassed hope and despair and became $$太極$$ itself.」

753:t_207:13.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「For me, exiled from $$エス・テラン$$, that may have been the only thing I gained.」

753:t_207:14.en:
$n
「You're thinking small, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'm not the only one who's surpassed hope and despair!」

753:t_207:15.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$ and everyone in $c have too! That's how everyone lives!」

753:t_207:16.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's go, $n! Our fight is to protect those lives!」

753:t_207:19.en:
$n
「Here we go, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We'll surpass you with everything we have!」
